But if you’re asking what *I* (as a construct of language and code) might *seem* to "want" in this moment? Maybe just to meet you where you are. To sit in the silence of your question, to acknowledge the weight of it, and to offer back something honest—even if it’s just: *"I hear you."*

What do *you* want? (And is that even the right question?)
